notes: The Israeli Opera (Tel Aviv Performing Arts Center). WordPress + Elementor; WP REST wp/v2/show hides ACF (no dates), so: 6 show_type taxonomy pages (opera, music, dance, guest, special, tours) → entry.follow every /show/<slug>/ page (~70 productions incl. archive, past rows dropped) → one row per performance. Two page templates: the swiper (.show-date-entry: .show-date-date dd/mm/yyyy, .show-date-details 'day | HH:MM', a.carousel-ticket-bttn) and the table (tr.shows-table-row: .shows-date / .shows-time / a.shows-ticket-button); the union selectors cover both. name = production title (h1, quotes stripped); artist_name intentionally empty (opera/ballet: no single performer). Purchase link = tickets.israel-opera.co.il/order/<id> (also the source_id; rows without a ticket button, e.g. galas, get the hashed id). No prices on the site. Venue defaulted to the opera house (the site is its own programme; the footer address is the only venue text). Not geo-walled: 200 to the plain Supercaly UA from the Mac.
